name: Obey
overview: Scripture reveals that obedience to God is a vital expression of love and faithfulness, as seen in commands to keep His statutes and commandments (Deuteronomy 11:1; John 14:15). Obedience distinguishes God's people as His treasured possession when they heed His voice and uphold His covenant (Exodus 19:5). Believers are called to prioritize obedience to God above human authority (Acts 5:29), recognizing that their allegiance determines whether they serve sin leading to death or righteousness leading to life (Romans 6:16). Hearing and keeping God's word is the mark of true blessing (Luke 11:28), underscoring that obedience is both a response to God's love and a pathway to His favor.
